annotations.title: Where do buyers find options when they search?

description: Use when the user is planning go-to-market or channel strategy and asks where buyers look, whether to prioritise retail, review sites, their own site or communities, or who controls the first page for their category. Searches Google live for 1-3 buyer queries and classes every top-10 organic result by domain: retailers and marketplaces, reviews and media, brand sites, forums and social, reference, independent and specialist sites. Returns the share each class holds, who leads each class, and who takes the top three places. Domains and counts only. Safe to cite: its controls are checked first, it states its limits, and every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. If a control fails it refuses and you are not charged. This tool charges nothing: it validates the request and returns a payment_url, the price and instructions. Pay by POSTing to payment_url over MPP (HTTP 402, a Stripe shared payment token from your wallet). Price: $3.00 per run, charged only when the run comes back sound; pay over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token) or x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed). A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/channel-mix.json

brand_domains.description: Optional: the category's brand sites, comma-separated, so they are classed as brands.

media_domains.description: Optional: specialist review or media sites to class as media.

retailer_domains.description: Optional: specialist retailers to class as retailers.
